item.title: In photos: New Shajareh-ye Tayyebeh School opens in Minab
item.description: A new Shajareh-ye Tayyebeh School was inaugurated in Minab, Hormozgan Province, on September 23, 2026, marking the start of the 2026–27 school year with a ceremony honoring the memory of 168 student martyrs. The event was attended by Vice President Hossein Afshin, Tehran Mayor Alireza Zakani, Deputy Education Minister Rezvan Hakimzadeh, and families of martyrs and survivors.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/photo/86272492/In-photos-New-Shajareh-ye-Tayyebeh-School-opens-in-Minab

A new Shajareh-ye Tayyebeh School was inaugurated in Minab, Hormozgan Province, on September 23, 2026, marking the start of the 2026–27 school year with a ceremony honoring the memory of 168 student martyrs. The event was attended by Vice President Hossein Afshin, Tehran Mayor Alireza Zakani, Deputy Education Minister Rezvan Hakimzadeh, and families of martyrs and survivors.

item.title: In photos: Iran’s wushu team secures four medals at 2026 Asian Games
item.description: Iran’s wushu team secured four medals on the third day of the Nagoya 2026 Asian Games after four Iranian sanda fighters advanced to the semifinals, while Helia Asadian narrowly missed out on a bronze medal in the taolu competition, finishing fourth by just 0.003 points.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/photo/86272180/In-photos-Iran-s-wushu-team-secures-four-medals-at-2026-Asian

Iran’s wushu team secured four medals on the third day of the Nagoya 2026 Asian Games after four Iranian sanda fighters advanced to the semifinals, while Helia Asadian narrowly missed out on a bronze medal in the taolu competition, finishing fourth by just 0.003 points.
